component.name: KShadowLrc
component.summary: Floating desktop lyrics overlay for KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland

description.p: KShadowLrc draws the lyrics of the track that is playing on a floating overlay that sits on top of the other windows. It is a wlr-layer-shell surface, so on Plasma 6 Wayland it stays above the desktop, out of the taskbar and click-through without any window rule, and it follows the output and the position it is configured for.

The playing track is read from the desktop's media players over MPRIS: title, artist, album, length and the playback position, which the overlay follows while the track plays and pauses. Lyrics are looked up by title, artist and duration and are kept in a local cache, so a track that has been played once loads its lyrics without a lookup. When the source has a translation for a line, it is shown next to the original, or instead of it, as configured.

Font family and size, text colour, outline, the number of visible lines and the line layout, where the overlay sits on the screen and click-through can be configured; a lyric offset compensates for a player that reports its position imprecisely.
